data: Which of the following methods reach an AUC-PR score of more than 80% at 10^4 training samples?

The question asks which methods achieve an AUC-PR score of more than 80% at 10^4 training samples. From the caption, we know that the top graph represents AUC-PR scores. The blue line corresponds to Supervised Training, and the orange line corresponds to Self-Supervised Pretraining & Supervised Finetuning. 

Looking at the top graph, both lines show an upward trend as the number of training samples increases. At approximately 10^4 training samples, the blue line (Supervised Training) is below 80%, while the orange line (Self-Supervised Pretraining & Supervised Finetuning) is above 80%. Therefore, the method represented by the orange line reaches an AUC-PR score of more than 80% at 10^4 training samples.
